Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand as possible?

Card Q&A.a: You can add 1 card with the [Dragonkin] or [Cyborg] trait and 1 card named [Ryo Akiyama] or 1 Option card with the [Device] trait.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be added to my hand using this card's [On Play] effect?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Dragonkin] or [Cyborg] trait and 1 [Ryo Akiyama] or [Device] trait Option card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
